name: Combined layout
intent: Combine flat, island, and inset principles across page zones or platforms when the page has mixed semantic structures.

separation.rule: Do not mix spacing, background gaps, and inset gaps at the same semantic hierarchy level.

zoneRules: Hero or broad marketing content may use flat.
Independent listing, map, and sidebar zones may use island.
Forms, checkout steps, booking groups, and settings groups may use inset.
avoid: Using combined when one principle is enough
validation: Every major zone has a local principle.
Separation methods do not conflict at the same hierarchy level.
No zone creates standalone Background Primary content chunks.
App/touch island radius is 32px and desktop island radius is 40px where islands are used.
